utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Case number IT-98-32-T, the Prosecutor versus Mitar Vasiljevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Now, Mr. Groome, are you ready for your first witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. GROOME
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. The Prosecution calls VG81. Your Honour, the entire subject of this witness's testimony will be the matter that was conducted in private session with the Witness (redacted) so I'm going to ask that (redacted) testimony be taken in private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: Yes, thank you. We will now go into private session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE HUNT
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Tuesday, the 11th day of December, 2001, at 9.30 a.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.04 p.m.,
